description: A harbinger of Voidreach's entropy who tears unstable portals in the fabric of reality, unleashing devastating dimensional energy. Each rift they open weakens the world a little more.
icon_hint: jagged dimensional tear with unstable purple energy spilling outward
card_prompt: Pixel art, SNES style. A decorative card frame background for a fantasy void herald entropy mage class. Jagged unstable border with crackling purple energy tears at corners and warping edges. Pitch black center with violent purple-red entropy tears ripping across surface and unstable energy arcs. Small jagged dimensional tear at bottom leaking purple light. Color palette: pitch black, entropy purple, rift red. No characters, no text.
